shots.focal_element: Funnel bar chart (Welcome, User Sign Up, Follow Playlist, Play Song or Video) with the Total Conversion headline metric, plus the 'Completed within' conversion-window control in the left rail
on_screen_text: From Welcome to Play Song or Video within the last 30 days.
shots.typography: Native product UI text only (no added captions or titles): neutral geometric/grotesque sans (low-confidence guess: Inter-like), large bold headline metric, medium-weight sentence-case labels, small regular-weight body and axis labels, default tracking.
shots.what_happens: Unbroken ~60 s full-screen recording of the Amplitude funnel chart. Opens with the fourth event (Play Song or Video) being added via the event dropdown; the chart reloads and Total Conversion changes from 22.1% to 19.5%. While the voice-over explains default settings and the conversion window (w150-w214), red outline boxes call out the 30d date-range toggle and the 'Completed within 1 days' control. The cursor opens that control and sets it to 30 minutes (w233-w242); the chart greys out, reloads, and the headline drops to 6.11%, which gets a red callout box (w243-w265). A red box then frames the User Sign Up and Follow Playlist bars as the biggest drop-off (w266-w285), and the cursor hovers the upper (dropped-off) part of the Follow Playlist bar to raise a tooltip (w286-w294). In the final frame the whole UI appears to begin scaling up, leading into the next shot's zoom.
shots.build_rebuild: Play a full-bleed 1080p UI capture at 1x with no camera moves, and on cue with specific VO word indices overlay 2 px red rounded-rectangle outline callouts (hard on/off, no animation) around the control or metric being discussed.
